title: 25 PhD Positions at the Max Planck School of Biomedical AI
institution: Max Planck School of Biomedical Artificial Intelligence
about: The Max Planck School of Biomedical Artificial Intelligence offers 25 PhD positions in a structured three-year program across Germany, starting September 2027. Students are co-supervised by two fellows; applicants name up to three potential supervisors and submit a CV, motivation letter and transcripts.
requirements: Master's in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, or a computational life science

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: "Biomedical artificial intelligence" (field) → "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support"
"Master's in ... a computational life science" (qualification) → "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
